controls.name: typed storage preserves exact native bytes including negative zero and nonfinite evidence
nonindexed triangle uses full nonidentity parent world transform
indexed geometry keeps topology, groups and actual draw range separately from full buffer
interleaved native position offset and stride decode without repacking guesses
instances respect native active count and compose instance with parent world matrix
changed geometry without a version bump creates a fresh immutable evidence record
pose changes preserve geometry identity while recording fresh matrices
malformed buffers, normalized position and half/skinned deformation stay explicit
cycles, functions and unknown numeric metadata remain serialized evidence
buffer integrity hashes exact bytes independently of producer certificate metadata
deep native graph references stay explicit IDs instead of overflowing transport depth
safe local repeated polygon point resolves within the property root and preserves functions as metadata
unknown or ambiguous safe references fail explicitly without guessing a closure or graph

scope: Lossless native geometry encoding/independent decoding CPU controls. No regenerated-world or physical support acceptance.
